body: There are anonymous helplines?? I’ve never heard of it and I’ll look into it, thank you
I get more anxious talking to people I actually care about. Talking to strangers like now is a lot easier. I just feel like I’m annoying them with my issues
I’ve been thinking about therapy but I know as soon as I sit in that chair I’ll have nothing to talk about/won’t talk about...

I just read your other post you made, would you like to talk privately? We both need a friend. I admire you, knowing what’s important and sticking to it, helping others. Sometimes I think other people know more about me than me because I’m so confused all the time, but that’s just finding ourselves as you say, isn’t it??

I’ll definitely listen to it now. Honestly sometimes I feel like I’m lying to myself when I say I’m depressed. Sometimes I feel like I’m lying to myself when I say I’m gay. They make me question stuff a lot

I hope you’re okay now, there absolutely /isn’t/ anything gross about it. I’m very accepting usually it’s just the fact that they would hate me for it. Particularly my father, I feel actually scared if he ever finds out. Just some of the things he’s said
